{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yang Metal Horse''' (庚午, ''kanoe uma''; onyomi ''kōgo'') is the 7th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|af|Sestigdelige siklus|ar|دورة ستينية|arz|دوره ستينيه|as|ষাঠি বছৰীয়া আৱৰ্তন|ast|Ciclu sexaxenariu|bn|ষাটবার্ষিক চক্র|ca|Cicle sexagesimal|cdo|Găng-ciĕ|cs|Kan-č’|de|60-Jahre-Zyklus|eo|Ĉina sesdekjara ciklo|es|Ciclo sexagesimal chino|eu|Hirurogeitaka urteko ziklo|fa|چرخه شصت‌تایی|fr|Cycle sexagésimal chinois|hak|Kôn-chṳ̂|hy|Վաթսունամյա շրջան|id|Ganzhi|it|Ganzhi|ja|干支|ka|სამოცეული ციკლი|ko|간지|mk|Шеесетгодишен циклус|ms|Ganzhi|nn|Sekstiårig syklus|no|Sekstiårig syklus|ru|Система гань-чжи|sh|Seksagenarni ciklus|simple|Sexagenary cycle|su|Daur séksagenari|sv|Himmelska stammar och jordiska grenar|th|แผนภูมิสวรรค์|tr|Altmışlık döngü|uk|Шістдесятирічний цикл|vi|Can Chi|wuu|干支|xmf|გან-ჩჟიშ სისტემა|za|Gancei|zh|干支|zh_classical|干支|zh_min_nan|Kan-chi|zh_yue|干支|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 7th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yin Earth Snake|ja|己巳}} and followed by {{ill|Yin Metal Goat|af|Metaalbok (astrologie)|cdo|Sĭng-ê|de|Metall-Schaf|fr|Chèvre de métal|hak|Sîn-vi|ja|辛未|ko|신미 (간지)|nds|Metall-Schaap|vi|Tân Mùi|za|Sinmeih|zh|辛未|zh_min_nan|Sin-bī|zh_yue|辛未|qid=Q1062873}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|af|Hemelstam|ca|Troncs celestes|cdo|Tiĕng-găng|de|Himmelsstämme|es|Troncos celestiales|fa|شاخه‌های آسمانی|fi|Taivaalliset rungot|fr|Tige céleste|gan|天干|hak|Thiên-kôn|id|Batang Langit|it|Tronco celeste|ja|十干|ko|천간|mk|Небесни стебла|ms|Tiangan|nl|Hemelse Stammen|pl|Niebiańskie pnie|ru|Небесные стволы|tr|Göksel Gövdeler|uk|Небесні стовбури|za|Diengan|zh|天干|zh_min_nan|Thian-kan|zh_yue|天干|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''庚'' is Yang Metal, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''午'' (Horse) is Yang Fire; together they form a Mutual Destruction relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yang Metal Horse (庚午)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): gēngwǔ
** Cantonese (Jyutping): gaang1 ng5
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: kanoe-uma
*** On'yomi: kōgo
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): gyeongo (경오)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Canh Ngọ

==Years of Yang Metal Horse==
A {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era}} year that leaves a remainder of 10 when divided by 60 is a year of Yang Metal Horse (庚午).
For years before the Common Era, a year is a Kanoe-uma year if, when divided by 60, the remainder is 51.

=== Notable Events ===
* Birth year of {{ill|Emperor Jimmu|en|Emperor Jimmu|qid=Q200188|lt=Emperor Jimmu}}, the legendary first emperor of Japan.
* Year 670 AD - {{ill|Koseki system in classical Japan|ja|庚午年籍|ja_comment=fixed jawiki redirect|3=古代日本の戸籍制度|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11410913}}, an important early census system in Japan under {{ill|Emperor Tenji|en|Emperor Tenji|qid=Q314802|lt=Emperor Tenji}}.
* Year 1870 AD - {{ill|Q11485995|ja|庚午事変|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11485995}}.

==Months of Yang Metal Horse==
In years where the last digit is 4 or 9 (corresponding to the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|af|Hemelstam|ca|Troncs celestes|cdo|Tiĕng-găng|de|Himmelsstämme|es|Troncos celestiales|fa|شاخه‌های آسمانی|fi|Taivaalliset rungot|fr|Tige céleste|gan|天干|hak|Thiên-kôn|id|Batang Langit|it|Tronco celeste|ja|十干|ko|천간|mk|Небесни стебла|ms|Tiangan|nl|Hemelse Stammen|pl|Niebiańskie pnie|ru|Небесные стволы|tr|Göksel Gövdeler|uk|Небесні стовбури|za|Diengan|zh|天干|zh_min_nan|Thian-kan|zh_yue|天干|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stems}} of Kō (甲) or Ki (己)), the fifth month (May) is a Kanoe-uma month. However, the definition may apply to the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦}} or {{ill|Solar term|af|Sontermyn|ar|فصل شمسي|ast|Términos solares|cdo|Cáik-ké|cs|24 ťie-čchi|eo|Suna Periodo|es|Términos solares|fr|Période solaire|hak|Chiet-hì|he|תקופות חמה (לוח השנה הסיני)|id|Posisi matahari|ja|二十四節気|ko|절기|ms|Jieqi|ro|Termen solar|th|ภาวะ (ปฏิทินจีน)|tr|Güneş dönemi|vi|Tiết khí|wuu|節氣|za|Cietheiq|zh|节气|zh_classical|節氣|zh_min_nan|Cheh-khùi|zh_yue|節氣|qid=Q1190993|lt=Solar term}} (from {{ill|Mangzhong|en|Mangzhong|qid=Q1147880|lt=Mangzhong}} to the day before {{ill|Xiaoshu|en|Xiaoshu|qid=Q1190976|lt=Xiaoshu}}).

==Days of Yang Metal Horse==
=== Special Calendar Significance ===
Kanoe-uma days have the following calendar attributes:
* {{ill|Tsuchi (Japanese term)|ja|犯土|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11571306}} (First day of major land restriction periods)
* {{ill|Rekichū Gedan|ja|神吉日|ja_comment=fixed jawiki redirect|3=暦注下段|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11514957}} (Auspicious day for shrine visits)
* {{ill|Rekichū Gedan|ja|大明日|ja_comment=fixed jawiki redirect|3=暦注下段|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11514957}} (Auspicious day for general affairs)

== Other Uses ==
In {{ill|Hiroshima|en|Hiroshima|qid=Q34664|lt=Hiroshima}}, the {{ill|Q11485994|ja|庚午 (広島市)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11485994}} was named after the year 1870, in which it was developed.
